## Permission/template or core change?

Sail's trusted core is intentionally minimal. Most new DeFi integrations are **permissions /
templates** that anyone can deploy and register — those do **not** require a kernel change and are
the preferred path. Please indicate which this is:

- [ ] New permission/template (or change to an existing template) — no core change
- [ ] Documentation / tooling
- [ ] **Trusted-core change** (`SailKernel` / `SailGovernance`) — higher bar; expect discussion
      before a large PR
